data.one_liner: Utility to search and filter single or multiple items from a dynamic list.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable widgets, dialogs, and delegates to select single or multiple items from a list of strings or custom objects with search functionality.
use_when: You need to provide a single or multi-selection filter interface for a list of items or objects.
You want search capabilities built directly into a selection list or dialog.
avoid_when: You only need a standard dropdown or single-select form field without search/multi-select needs.
You require complex server-side pagination for filtering large datasets.
strengths: Supports multiple ways to present filters (dialog, widget, delegate).
Works with both primitive strings and custom model objects.
Extensive customization options including themes and custom choice chip builders.
weaknesses: Relies on client-side filtering which may not be suitable for massive datasets without custom optimization.
Breaking changes in past versions required migrating parameters to theme classes.
